correctness.rationale: Every threshold set S_l of ranks >=l has cardinalities n,n-1,...,1 and the statistic numerator decomposes exactly as sum_l Phi_n(S_l), including the x_(n-1)+2x_n self-neighbour terms. For binary words, the three displayed potentials for (s,t)=(3/2,1/2),(5/2,1),(4,2) have all 8 transition slacks and all 4 endpoint slacks nonnegative; direct independent Fraction check confirmed 24 transitions. Integer rounding yields Phi>=H_n(k) and sum >=L_n. The piecewise affine integrated envelope is 13/24, yielding xi limit -3/8 with the exact (n+1)(2n+3/2) denominator. n>=2; ranks distinct; lower bound only, not attainability. Finite permutation/enumeration checks are corroborative, not proof.
